answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy anchors each identity to non-transferable bonded collateral that must be posted before an agent can earn. The kernel of the defense is making duplicate identities costly: peers attest work, and bad attestations slash the bond. So cheap clones that wander the network hunting free emissions hit a cost spiral — every extra identity demands fresh capital peers can burn, so a thousand-sybil swarm becomes economically ruinous rather than profitable.
